user_intent: 期望 亮度 处于 261 lux 到 781 lux
期望 温度 处于 24 ℃ 到 28 ℃
期望 声音 处于 87 dB
IF 人不在家 THEN 清洁环境
如果 人在家 那么 提高环境香味
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF xiaomi_brightness_guard.brightness() < 261 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN light_up() xiaomi_smart_light
IF xiaomi_brightness_guard.brightness() > 781 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN light_down() xiaomi_smart_light
IF xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.get_illuminance() < 261 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN light_up() xiaomi_smart_light
IF xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.get_illuminance() > 781 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN light_down() xiaomi_smart_light
IF sprite_temperature_humidity_sensor_KD30.get_temperature() > 28 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN switch_cooling_mode() NWT_Internet_Mobile_Air_Conditioner
IF sprite_temperature_humidity_sensor_KD30.get_temperature() < 24 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN switch_heating_mode() NWT_Internet_Mobile_Air_Conditioner
IF xiaomi_volume_sensor.reading() > 87 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN set_volume_low() xiaomi_television
IF xiaomi_volume_sensor.reading() < 87 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN set_volume_high() xiaomi_television
